name: Stride Manufacturing
old_description: We partner with brands to design, develop, and deliver fully custom apparel at scale.
about:
Stride Manufacturing operates from Tulsa, Oklahoma, as a full-service apparel and merchandise partner. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available materials.

The firm manages the entire apparel lifecycle: concept and strategy, artwork and design, sampling and prototyping, approvals and compliance, and manufacturing through a vetted network of factory partners that handle cut-and-sew, embroidery, and embellishments. It also oversees logistics and fulfillment, including packaging, warehousing, and direct-to-consumer delivery. Production scale ranges from roughly one hundred pieces to tens of thousands per order.

Stride serves brands and businesses launching new labels, scaling streetwear lines, or developing private-label merchandise. Its customer base includes retailers, e-commerce operators, and companies seeking custom apparel programs. The company cites work with streetwear labels and corporate merch programs as typical engagements.

Stride emphasizes a 'no middlemen' model, an in-house creative team, and a global network of trusted, ethical factories. It highlights transparent communication, end-to-end logistics, and direct-to-consumer dropshipping as differentiators. The company has been recognized with awards such as Emerging Apparel Manufacturer (2023) and Top Product Development Firm (2024).
